faq_heading: Homes near Simonds Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Simonds Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Simonds Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Simonds Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Simonds Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 73 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,213,750, townhomes $625,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Simonds Elementary?
faq.a: For the 73 homes that sold within 1 km of Simonds Elementary, the median time on the market was 21 days and the median sale was 96.4% of list; 8% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Simonds Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are H D Stafford Middle (0.6 km east), Alice Brown Elementary (0.7 km south) and Nicomekl Elementary (1.0 km north).

Simonds Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20190 48 Ave. It teaches grades K to 5. Programs listed: U-Connect; StrongStart (district find-a-school tag).
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Simonds Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Simonds Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Simonds Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Simonds Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 73 homes sold within 1 km of Simonds Elementary: 60 houses, 10 townhomes and 3 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,213,750.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Simonds Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Simonds Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 2 secondary, 1 middle, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is H D Stafford Middle, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Murrayville Academy, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Alice Brown Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest secondary school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (2.1 km); the nearest independent school is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Alice Brown Elementary (0.7 km south), Nicomekl Elementary (1.0 km north), Uplands Elementary (1.2 km south-east), Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Douglas Park Community (1.6 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Nicomekl Elementary, 1.0 km north of Simonds Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Simonds Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from Simonds Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Simonds Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Simonds Elementary was $1,213,750, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Alice Brown Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south of Simonds Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
